items.name: PathPrinter
items.summary: A printer file paths, with optional color and hyperlink support.

methods.name: write
methods.summary: Write the given path to the underlying writer.

items.summary: A builder for a printer that emits file paths.

methods.name: build
methods.signature: fn build<W: WriteColor>(&self, wtr: W) -> PathPrinter<W>

methods.signature: fn color_specs(&mut self, specs: ColorSpecs) -> &mut PathPrinterBuilder
methods.summary: Set the user color specifications to use for coloring in this printer.

methods.name: hyperlink
methods.signature: fn hyperlink(&mut self, config: HyperlinkConfig) -> &mut PathPrinterBuilder
methods.summary: Set the configuration to use for hyperlinks output by this printer.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Return a new path printer builder with a default configuration.

methods.name: separator
methods.signature: fn separator(&mut self, sep: Option<u8>) -> &mut PathPrinterBuilder
